new_today_news.headline: New Jersey Extends Exemption, Delays Recycled Content Requirements for Food Packaging Until 2029
new_today_news.summary: New Jersey postponed recycled content requirements for food packaging containers until December 31, 2029, drawing opposition from the plastics recycling industry. Related to broader waste management regulatory environment affecting food service businesses.

new_today_news.headline: RFS Set 2: Record Renewable Fuel Volumes and Energy Dominance
new_today_news.summary: EPA's RFS Set 2 final rule (issued March 27, 2026) establishes record-setting renewable fuel volumes for 2026 and 2027, with provisions aimed at boosting domestic biofuel production by reallocating 70% of small refinery exemption volumes.

new_today_news.headline: Fertile Earth Receives Authorization for Food-to-Food Recycling in Palm Beach County
new_today_news.summary: Fertile Earth received authorization from the Solid Waste Authority of Palm Beach County to operate a Food-to-Food Recycling Program, collecting pre-consumer food scraps for delivery to participating animal farms. While not directly FOG-focused, this program addresses organic waste management in commercial food generation.
